cards.title: Leads
cards.text: When a visitor is interested, the agent sends the owner the lead itself, once, after their yes.

cards.title: SendLead
cards.text: Name, a way to reach them and what they want. A lead with a part missing says which.

cards.title: A sender behind a seam
cards.text: Resend's API sends the mail. On a PC and in the tests the lead only goes to the log.

cards.title: Failures as text
cards.text: A sender's failure comes back with its reason, never a throw into the loop.
